overviewParagraphs: Pineapple Valley Golf Club is one of Hua Hin's most consistently enjoyable championship experiences — a course built on former pineapple plantation land that retains the gentle rolling terrain and tropical vegetation of its agricultural past while providing immaculate championship-level conditioning and facilities throughout.

The layout is refreshingly honest in its design: no artificial drama, no manufactured features — just well-crafted holes that reward thoughtful play, excellent greens, and the kind of lush, green-on-green visual palette that makes tropical golf feel genuinely special. The transitions between plantation-remnant rough and meticulously maintained fairways are aesthetically striking.

For Hua Hin itineraries, AGS regularly combines Pineapple Valley with Black Mountain to offer clients the full spectrum of what the destination provides: the dramatic mountain granite character of Black Mountain against the flowing, plantation-green beauty of Pineapple Valley.

curatorBriefHtml: Pineapple Valley Golf Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Hua Hin, Thailand, crafted by Pirapon Namatra / Golf East (2009) and stretching to 6,774 Yards (Blue Tees) across a former pineapple plantation, gently rolling environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its natural foothill contours & pineapple fields (Organic natural routing) and elevated tee vistas toward mountain range (Panoramic Burmese border vistas).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Pineapple Valley Golf Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Thailand dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie green slopes expertise (Reads subtle mountain grain), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Hua Hin golf tour by AGS, Pineapple Valley Golf Club provides a distinct architectural test by Pirapon Namatra / Golf East that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Pineapple Valley Golf Club?
faqs.a: Pineapple Valley Golf Club in Hua Hin, Thailand is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Pirapon Namatra / Golf East (opened 2009), measuring 6,774 Yards (Blue Tees) within a former pineapple plantation, gently rolling setting. It is particularly noted for natural foothill contours & pineapple fields (Organic natural routing).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Pineapple Valley Golf Club?
faqs.a: Pineapple Valley Golf Club operates under resort & visitor access via ags protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie green slopes expertise (Reads subtle mountain grain)), and private VIP transfers from your Hua Hin hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Pineapple Valley Golf Club?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Pineapple Valley Golf Club's elevated tee vistas toward mountain range (Panoramic Burmese border vistas) alongside natural foothill contours & pineapple fields (Organic natural routing). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Pineapple Valley Golf Club?
